title: Make release gates trustworthy
description: Establish trustworthy release validation and evidence.
tasks: Separate environment-only failures from code failures.
Reduce active-source lint debt in safe, reviewable batches.
Keep production build and targeted smoke tests passing.
Archive validation evidence for release-candidate review.
definition_of_done: npm run build has a documented result.
npm run lint has a documented result or intentional exclusions are documented.
MASTER_CHECKLIST.md reflects the current gate state.
